name: Drifting Pollen
text: A haze of pollen floats around you. A creature in your kinetic aura when you enter the stance, or who later enters the aura or ends its turn in the aura, attempts at a Fortitude save save against your class DC. On a failure, it's Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure) and Dazzled until it's no longer sickened. A creature attempts this save no more than once per round and doesn't attempt a new save if already affected.
